title: Full Visual UI, Responsive & Component Consistency Audit
method: real Chromium (Edge) rendering via Playwright against a local HTTP server; no static-only inference used for any pass/fail claim

templates.name: homepage_legacy
templates.note: lighter content block, documented in Phase 3/4, not this phase's scope

templates.name: self_contained_inline
templates.note: no shared base stylesheet by design; verified rendering correctly, not a defect

templates.name: sample_request
templates.note: real defect found and fixed here (H1)

viewport_matrix.result: 0 horizontal overflow, 0 console errors, 0 failed requests across the 350-cell matrix

findings.title: Skip-to-content link visibly overlapping the logo on sample-request.html
findings.root_cause: margin-collapse: .sample-hero{margin-top:170px} collapses through the empty #header-placeholder into body (page sets body{position:relative}), shifting the containing block of the shared header's position:absolute skip-link so it renders on-screen instead of off-screen at top:-60px

findings.title: Mobile hero image 404 on 4 rebuilt locale homepages
findings.root_cause: mobile <source srcset> missing ../ prefix required from locale subdirectory; sibling <link rel=preload> already had it correctly
findings.fix: added ../ prefix to the mobile <source srcset> path in all 4 files

findings.title: 'Order on WhatsApp' CTA renders in English on locale product pages
findings.root_cause: no governed translation for this exact source string exists yet in data/localized-copy-cache.json (confirmed null for all 10 locales)
findings.reason_not_fixed: content/translation gap, not a layout defect; this phase's rules forbid machine-translating content; requires a human-reviewed translation per locale similar to the Phase 2 cache-population workflow

findings.title: audit_localizations.py did not catch the M1 English-residue gap
findings.reason_not_fixed: out of this phase's visual-audit scope; flagged for whoever addresses M1

findings.title: product-catalogue.html: skip-link selector not found during a diagnostic pass
findings.reason_not_fixed: could not reproduce an actual visible/functional problem; page passed the full 350-cell matrix (0 overflow, 0 console errors, 0 failed requests); flagged for closer look in a future phase rather than acted on without a confirmed reproduction

findings.title: 4 pages do not load the base design-system stylesheets
findings.note: each carries a complete, correctly-rendering self-contained inline stylesheet; legitimate architectural variation, not inconsistency; sample-request.html's unrelated H1 bug was still fixed

findings.title: href="#" used for several JS-triggered action buttons
findings.reason_not_fixed: functions correctly, no dead-end navigation; semantic/cosmetic only

findings.title: Legacy FontAwesome @font-face declarations report status:unloaded
findings.reason_not_fixed: unused superseded declarations; no visible FOUT/FOIT or layout shift observed

false_positives_corrected.description: ~300 images flagged 'broken' by an automated check that read img.complete/naturalWidth before scrolling triggered loading=lazy images
false_positives_corrected.verification: 8 files spot-checked directly on disk (exist); flagcdn.com external resource confirmed reachable via direct curl

false_positives_corrected.description: Cookie bar read as 'not dismissable' by Playwright is_visible(), which does not account for transform:translate() moving the element off-screen
false_positives_corrected.verification: getBoundingClientRect() showed the bar moves from y:744 to y:860 (off-screen) after clicking Accept; localStorage correctly records 'accepted'

cookie_bar.result: pass, corrected false positive noted above

rtl_audit.finding: M1 (Order on WhatsApp untranslated) surfaced here

accessibility_visual_spot_check.zoom_200_400_homepage: no horizontal overflow introduced, no overlapping text
accessibility_visual_spot_check.scope_note: symptom recording only; full WCAG remediation explicitly out of scope for this phase

performance_visual_signals.lazy_loading: confirmed deliberate and correct usage, not a defect

deployment: not performed; all changes remain local, uncommitted working-tree changes
